raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768543592000) instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. 1768543592000 ms is 2026-01-16 06:06:32 UTC, which matches the ~06:00 start and the one-day ingest lag seen in other batches, so converting epoch ms as UTC is unambiguous.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_ts ~ '^[0-9]{13}$' THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p"}}
